name: RobotEra STAR1
summary: STAR1 is RobotEra's earlier full-size humanoid, about 1.7 m and 65 kg, with joints up to 400 N·m. In October 2024 it ran at about 8 mph through the Gobi Desert wearing sneakers. RobotEra's newer L7 now leads its bipedal lineup.
highlights: Ran at about 8 mph for 34 minutes in the Gobi Desert (October 2024).
Joint torque up to 400 N·m with planetary reducers and high-precision encoders.
caveats: Speed demo was company-produced; terrain and conditions were chosen by RobotEra.
Status as superseded is inferred from L7 being the newer full-size bipedal model.

sources.title: Robot Era's STAR1 Humanoid Robot Puts on Sneakers, Goes Running in Gobi Desert
More than a hardware play: Robot Era's founder sets the record straight
